hooks.command: G="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/attribution_guard.py"; [ -f "$G" ] || exit 0; if command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then py -3 "$G"; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$G"; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then python "$G"; else echo 'attribution_guard: no Python interpreter found' >&2; exit 2; fi
